1 · Does it fit the distribution shell?

The shell is holder · pool · detail. Mapped onto a compendium that is category · entry list · entry, the holder slot holds a category list rather than a subject — which is a real difference: a holder describes who the action is for, and a category describes where you are. The two candidates are drawn side by side.

2 · The Compact chain

At the floor both shapes collapse to the same sequential chain — category → list → entry — so the choice above is an Expanded-only question. What Compact decides instead is where history lives.

3 · Undiscovered content

Ruled by the owner 2026-08-15: undiscovered entries are hidden, not disabled-with-a-reason — a deliberate exception to the shell-wide availability vocabulary, because the reason string is the spoiler. Drawn here is the case that ruling does not by itself answer: a visible entry whose related links point at a hidden one.
